name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-tyran-castle
title: Chrono Trigger - Tyran Castle
description:
The epic song that plays in Tyranno Lair, divided into an ominous intro, a rock section and a dreamy interlude. In the txt file there's an option to turn on/off the intro.

Note: not compatible with thunder SFX/Blarggs and Bonus End. Also Yoshi will sound weird (not too awful though).
